pm.test('No confidential fields or local passwords in response',()=>{

(() => {const required=["adminEmail","adminPassword"];if(required.some(key=>!pm.environment.get(key)&&!pm.variables.get(key))){pm.execution.skipRequest();pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error('Populate local credentials or run prerequisites first (values not printed).');}})();

pm.test('Expected HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));if(pm.response.code!==200){pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);}else{pm.test('30-minute Bearer JWT and correct role',()=>{const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(Object.keys(b).sort()).to.eql(['accessToken','expiresIn','tokenType','user'].sort());pm.expect(Object.keys(b.user).sort()).to.eql(["accountStatus","createdAt","email","firstName","lastName","role","userId"]);pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql('Admin');pm.expect(b.expiresIn).to.eql(1800);pm.expect(b.tokenType).to.eql('Bearer');pm.expect(typeof b.accessToken).to.eql('string');});pm.environment.set('adminToken',pm.response.json().accessToken);pm.environment.set('adminId',pm.response.json().user.userId);}
